scope: Independent exact-byte, GDScript responsibility/lifecycle/observer and Godot GLES3 draw-command source review. No engine, browser, PCK construction or repository changes.

findings.result: Two concrete owner calls share only transient viewport construction/submission. Existing presentation resource owns lamp_texture; helper borrows it synchronously. No App/Session dependency or retained owner field. Headless Focus returns before allocations, and World guard avoids requesting an additional texture in headless.

Existing V3 on-screen rectangle remains mask0. Warm FocusQuad intentionally retains V3 default mask1 in a separate no-light World2D; do not describe warm quad as mask0. Same shared Shader, separate duplicated material and uniform values. Exported settings, real fade/visibility/time rules are unchanged.

A nondegenerate triangle lies at (1,1)..(7,7), and a positive-width 1px line spans (1,12)..(14,12), both inside 16x16. Engine maps polygon to TYPE_POLYGON/USE_ATTRIBUTES and positive-width line to four-point TYPE_PRIMITIVE/USE_PRIMITIVE. This supports intended draw-command selection, not measured GPU cache hits.

Existing 256px lamp texture is scaled to 32px and centered (8,8), covering both geometry bounds. PointLight default mask1, energy1 and z range include the default-z geometries. Separate geometry masks1/0 force different point-light membership, hence lit/unlit specialization when no directional lights exist in this private world. No world lights or occluders enter the viewport.

SubViewport UPDATE_ONCE is active on tree entry independent of texture usage; size>1 and independent World2D satisfy known rendering prerequisites. Underworld _node_added rejects its own descendants before deferred installation, so combat nodes do not get world shaders or enter that _seen. Foreground class/path filters reject these Node2D/helper-path, light and viewport nodes; Audio only observes BaseButton. Focus may still enter existing weak deferred installer/_seen as previously disclosed.

Owners parent the viewport; viewport parents light/quads. Built-in ObjectID queue_free connection is one-shot and not an owner-capturing closure. Parent destruction disposes owned subtree and incoming connection. Borrowed gradient texture remains held by original owner after transient light disappears. Post-draw is global, not per-viewport acknowledgement or GPU fence; threaded deferred callback timing, no-draw waiting and strict cleanup remain runtime obligations.

not_certified: Shader compilation/linking is actually completed or reused by first real shot/AIM.
Additional canvas variants, future same-canvas directional lights, particle/texture/hit/death pipelines are covered.
Startup CPU/GPU work is eliminated rather than shifted.
No visible flash, native parsing, pause/early-free strict exit, PCK import/export closure, browser performance, device or full-CI acceptance.
required_validation: Parse/run the real owners and test normal plus pre-first-draw parent destruction under strict exit.
Observe actual preparation WebGL sources/programs for both USE_ATTRIBUTES and USE_PRIMITIVE with lighting on/off; compare cold first-shot/air to source-frozen baseline.
Retain Focus V3 pixel/fade/time contract and headless behavior; measure startup cost and ensure offscreen nodes never become onscreen UI.
